shape.heading: You watch everything and rate almost nothing
paragraphs: Fewer than one in ten films gets a score, so the 30 ratings carry the whole profile. Everything else — the full Marvel run, all the Harry Potters, Minecraft Movie — is just what was on.

What the ratings keep circling is **doubling**. The Prestige has twins, Persona has two faces merging, Adaptation. has twin brothers. Being John Malkovich, The Double, Memento, Us, Companion, The Substance, Mickey 17. And underneath that, someone coming apart: Good Time, Joker, Hereditary, The King of Comedy, Saint Maud.

The correction from this round is that neither of those is sufficient on its own. Enemy is a man meeting his exact double and it got a shrug. Beau Is Afraid is three hours of unravelling and once was enough. **The unravelling has to arrive somewhere.** That was already in your own notes as "emotional payoff" and I under-weighted it.

ratingsNote: **The Prestige sits at 4½** despite being your most-rewatched film. Favourite and highest-rated are two different axes here, and recommendations should follow the first one.
watchNextNotes: Still on the list below the top twelve: The Wailing, Caché, The Vanishing, Inside Llewyn Davis, Blade Runner, Rosemary's Baby, Primer, Magnolia, Raw, Videodrome. Full set with reasons is in the data files.
**Demoted:** mother! was higher before. Given Beau Is Afraid was "once was enough," a two-hour escalating allegory with no landing is probably the same trip twice.
oldFilmsIntro: Not a rule any more. The evidence is genuinely mixed: the two oldest things you've rated both got five stars. What they have in common is short and blunt, not old and admired.
lineageIntro: This is the clearest structural finding on the page. Almost every director you've completed sits at the *end* of a line, and you've skipped the person they were copying. Filling those in is the highest-yield move available, and it explains the Bergman anomaly too.
cohortsIntro: Directors move in packs — same festivals, same money, same arguments. Where you're deep in a cohort, the missing members are unusually safe bets, because they were solving the same problem in the same room.
directorsIntro: You find someone, you go get the rest. Five filmographies are now closed.
